explication: Puck is a modular visual editor for authoring React pages with application-owned components and data. The main workflow is configuring components and fields, editing page data in the Puck interface, publishing that data through the host application, then rendering it as a React page. The graph also preserves documented React-framework usage and sampled slot, Contentful-field, and AI integration capabilities. Core runtime wiring beyond the supplied excerpts is represented conservatively; unsampled relationships are omitted.
